key_highlights: ASX tumbles as miners and banks sell off amid rising oil prices near $US100 and climbing bond yields
Iron ore trouble spreads, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX and the broader materials sector
Australian dollar 'shocker' looms as AUD weakens against USD, amplifying commodity-linked equity pressure
Aussie business conditions weakest since pandemic, signalling broad-based economic softening
Government softens local gas supply rules and abandons gas reservation, easing Asian energy fears but raising energy transition concerns
Bathla collapse ripples through private credit market, raising systemic risk concerns
Queensland on brink of credit rating downgrade, adding sovereign risk to ASX REITs and financials
WA gold exploration surge (Auric, Golden Dragon, Gateway, Forrestania) signals small-cap materials momentum
High-end property sees steepest price falls while affordable segment remains resilient
Austal jumps on $1.9b bid, providing a rare positive in industrials

sectors.trend: Sharp negative. Iron ore trouble spreads globally, dragging BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX lower. However, WA gold exploration activity is robust with multiple high-grade hits (Auric, Golden Dragon, Gateway, Forrestania) and copper/silver exploration expanding (Flagship, Patriot).
sectors.implications: Large-cap iron ore names face near-term downside; small-cap gold and base metals explorers offer relative strength. Diversify away from pure iron ore exposure.

sectors.trend: Negative. Banks sell off alongside miners as bond yields rise and business conditions hit pandemic lows. Bathla's collapse in private credit raises contagion fears. Queensland credit downgrade risk pressures state-linked lending.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from weak business conditions. Private credit exposure (via fund managers) warrants scrutiny. Queensland-linked REITs at risk.

sectors.trend: Mixed-to-positive. Oil near $US100 supports upstream producers. Government softens gas supply rules and abandons reservation, easing Asian fears but undermining energy transition narrative. Data centre power demand at coal plants creates new demand tailwind.
sectors.implications: Santos.AX, Woodside.AX, Origin.AX, AGL.AX benefit from gas policy shift and data centre demand. Coal-to-data-centre pivot (Power giant) is a structural theme.

sectors.trend: Neutral-to-positive. Medicare review recommends rebate increases, supporting CSL.AX, HIC.AX, and private health insurers. Insmed drug uptake disappointment is US-specific.
sectors.implications: Medicare rebate uplift is a medium-term positive for healthcare providers and CSL.AX distribution. Monitor policy implementation.

sectors.trend: Negative. High-end property sees steepest falls; NSW stamp duty hit threatens budget. Housing market divergence: affordable resilient, luxury weak. Business conditions at pandemic lows weigh on consumer spending.
sectors.implications: REITs (GP.AX, SPG.AX) face rental pressure in luxury segment. Consumer staples (WES.AX, WBC.AX) may see defensive rotation. NSW stamp duty cut risks fiscal tightening.

sectors.trend: Mixed. Austal jumps on $1.9b bid. Data centre build-out at coal plants creates infrastructure demand. Critical Resources battery tech passes month-long test.
sectors.implications: Austal.AX (ASX: AAT) is a near-term catalyst. Data centre infrastructure (A2M.AX, IAG.AX) and battery tech (CRB.AX) are structural growth themes.

key_themes: Commodity-driven ASX selloff: iron ore weakness + oil spike + rising yields create a risk-off environment
AUD weakness amplifies foreign-currency-denominated earnings pressure for miners
Gas policy pivot: government abandons reservation, softens supply rules — bullish for gas producers, bearish for renewables narrative
Private credit contagion: Bathla collapse signals broader credit market stress
WA gold exploration super-cycle: multiple high-grade discoveries support small-cap miners
Data centre energy demand: structural tailwind for power generators and infrastructure
Housing bifurcation: luxury correction vs affordable resilience
Business conditions at pandemic lows: macro headwind for cyclicals

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price deterioration and Chinese demand weakness
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX weightings; rotate into gold and base metals explorers
Hedge FX exposure; favour domestic-revenue companies (WES.AX, CSL.AX) over export-heavy miners
Review fund-of-funds and alternative credit exposure; favour listed bank equities over unlisted credit
Underweight QLD-domiciled REITs and state-linked infrastructure plays
Favour defensive sectors (healthcare, staples); reduce cyclical exposure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: NSW stamp duty revenue hit / fiscal tightening
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor NSW budget implications for property and infrastructure spending

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight WA gold explorers and producers
opportunities.rationale: Multiple high-grade discoveries (Auric 102koz, Golden Dragon, Gateway $45M drill-out, Forrestania offtake) signal a WA gold super-cycle; gold hedges AUD weakness and risk-off

opportunities.recommendation: Add gas and power generators on policy shift
opportunities.rationale: Government softens gas supply rules and abandons reservation; data centre demand at coal plants creates structural power demand tailwind
M&A catalyst provides near-term re-rating; shipbuilding sector benefits from global rearmament and energy transition demand

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight healthcare on Medicare rebate uplift
opportunities.rationale: Medicare review recommends increased rebates, supporting provider revenue and CSL.AX distribution volumes

defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore trouble spreads; Chinese inflation and demand weakness threaten pricing; AUD shocker amplifies FX headwinds

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim private credit and alternative fund exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Bathla collapse signals contagion risk in private credit; liquidity may dry up in stress scenarios

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight QLD-domiciled REITs and luxury property
defensive_moves.rationale: Queensland credit downgrade risk plus high-end property price falls create dual headwind

defensive_moves.recommendation: Increase cash / short-duration bonds as business conditions remain weak
defensive_moves.rationale: Pandemic-low business conditions suggest further cyclical deterioration; defensive positioning prudent

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX faces a perfect storm: iron ore weakness, oil spike raising input costs, rising bond yields, AUD depreciation, and pandemic-low business conditions. Expect ^AXJO to test lower supports. Miners and banks lead the decline. Gold and gas names are relative outperformers.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. WA gold exploration cycle, gas policy reform, data centre power demand, and Medicare rebate uplift provide structural tailwinds. However, iron ore structural oversupply and Chinese demand fragility cap the upside for large-cap miners. RBA likely to hold or cut given weak business conditions.

US inflation data (due today) and global rate path
Bathla fallout and private credit market stability
watch_list: RBA cash rate and unemployment data
WA gold explorer drill results (Auric, Gateway, Golden Dragon)
NSW budget stamp duty revenue impact
